svg.aria-label: What an adversarial review broke, what survived it, and what the headline became
svg.text: A review commissioned to refute this product's headline
Eight attacks. The mechanism survived every one. Three of the four published numbers did not.
SURVIVED
Shuffled-context placebo: keep the cluster geometry, destroy the
meaning. Recovery collapses. A strong positive control.
Detector-free measurement: the effect size holds with no threshold,
no alarm convention and no budget anywhere in it.
Unit selection, RUL cap, and four different detectors: direction
unchanged, magnitudes vary by up to 3x.
BROKEN
The raw arm got a third of the residual arm's healthy data,
and the difference was reported as the cost of regimes.
The threshold was chosen on the data it then scored, while the
code accepted a calibration argument it never read.
The recovery number came from an arm with n_regimes = 1:
a global regression with no segmentation in it at all.
What the headline became
An EFFECT SIZE, not a detector score. How large is the fault's signature against the spread across regimes,
and against the spread within one? No threshold rule or alarm convention can move it.
Six operating conditions: 0.16 sigma pooled, 11.95 sigma within regime.
One operating condition: exactly 1.00, because the two denominators are the same quantity.
That control was not designed. It is what the identical code returns on data with nothing to condition on,
and a number away from 1.00 there would mean the measurement is broken.
